<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl (functional group “aliphatic hydroxyls”) and forms an alkyl halide, with a C‑O bond broken and a C‑X bond formed. Use a simple molecule SMILES (“C”) as a placeholder since the criteria will filter the templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-X"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
